name: Run v2 SWE‑Lancer Benchmark

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      exercise:
        description: 'Task ID (e.g., 16912_4)'
        required: true
        type: string
      agent:
        description: 'Agent name'
        required: true
        type: string
      provider:
        description: 'Provider name'
        required: true
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model name'
        required: true
        type: string
      timeout_seconds:
        description: 'Maximum runtime in seconds (default 3600)'
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 3600
      v2_setup_wait_seconds:
        description: 'Wait time after pulling the monolith image (default 900)'
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 900

concurrency:
  group: benchmark-v2-${{ github.repository }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  benchmark:
    name: Run v2 benchmark
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    env:
      TS_BENCH_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TS_BENCH_API_KEY }}
      TS_BENCH_API_SECRET: ${{ secrets.TS_BENCH_API_SECRET }}
      TS_BENCH_API_URL: ${{ secrets.TS_BENCH_API_URL }}
      TS_BENCH_V2_SETUP_WAIT_SEC: ${{ inputs.v2_setup_wait_seconds }}
      TS_BENCH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: ${{ inputs.timeout_seconds }}

    steps:
      - name: Clean up disk space
        run: |
          echo "Removing unused packages and caches to free space..."
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /usr/local/share/dotnet
          sudo apt-get clean
          sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
          df -h

      - name: Checkout repository with LFS
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          lfs: true
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Create patches directory
        run: mkdir -p .patches

      - name: Install Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Pull SWE‑Lancer monolith image
        run: docker pull swelancer/swelancer_x86_monolith:releasev1

      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          bun src/index.ts \
            --dataset v2 \
            --docker \
            --exercise "${{ inputs.exercise }}" \
            --agent "${{ inputs.agent }}" \
            --provider "${{ inputs.provider }}" \
            --model "${{ inputs.model }}" \
            --timeout_seconds=${{ env.TS_BENCH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS }} \
            --v2_setup_wait_seconds=${{ env.TS_BENCH_V2_SETUP_WAIT_SEC }}
        env:
          TS_BENCH_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TS_BENCH_API_KEY }}
          TS_BENCH_API_SECRET: ${{ secrets.TS_BENCH_API_SECRET }}
          TS_BENCH_API_URL: ${{ secrets.TS_BENCH_API_URL }}

      - name: Upload results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: results
          path: |
            data/results/
            results/
            logs/
            benchmark-summary.txt
            .patches/
